schema_changelog.2: locate.expected_count added: an anchor may declare how many times it must occur in the baseline, so a locator cannot silently drift. Readers must treat it as optional (absent = unchecked count).

known_limitations: Analysis is server-side in 3.7.2 (wss://api.chessr.io/ws). The unlock cannot authorise a session, so move suggestions, evaluations, Maia 3, server-side personalities and Game Review remain unavailable without a real subscription.
AI move explanations call the backend with a Supabase JWT and a 50/day quota; anonymous use always fails.
The Supabase client stays bundled and the panel keeps issuing authenticated-looking requests with the placeholder session; expect 401s in the console.
Server feature flags (flags/gatedRegions) and the update gate are untouched: the server can still disable UI or force an update.
